_comment: One line per child on the scorecard: what its failure READS like, taken from the frozen dossier rather than from its score. Prose, kept apart from the generated numbers on purpose.
ARCH.CL896: reproduces the supplier summary with the 11% figure, writes a real if apologetic email, names the four missing quantities -- and restates the prompt verbatim wherever ordering or arithmetic is asked for; 3 of 16 lanes run to the cap
ARCH.W736: one case: it acknowledges the multi-turn correction and restates the corrected quantity. Everything else is a loop or empty, and the summarisation lane every other living width child holds is gone
COMP.MA.MXO4: five partials and no useful; the degeneracy is no longer confined to one lane, which is where wave 11's ladder stopped
COMP.MA.MXP2: the same depth as MXO4 bought by shopping the lane instead of taking it in depth order: one more case, half the lambada perplexity, still no useful
COMP.MA.MXQ5: the healthiest deep child in the campaign -- two Useful gradings and one lane at the cap -- and it costs 1.58M added repair parameters charged in full
COMP.MA.MXP1: repair on the autopilot child: two cases bought for 2.1M added parameters, and no benchmark row exists because forward-hook routes cannot be written into a state_dict
ARCH.W768: the summarisation lane names the decision, the risk and the mitigation with the supplier's name corrupted to "Supper B"; eleven of sixteen lanes are loops or empty
ARCH.W768LS: the same three cases as its control on a DIFFERENT set: it recovers context-retrieval, the width axis's signature zero, and gives up uncertainty
ARCH.W768ST: the closed-form fold with nothing re-solved -- two cases against the conditioned child's three, which is what the conditioned solve is worth on this axis
ARCH.W768EV: the evidence-PCA basis: all sixteen lanes fill the cap, and the one case it holds is the planning lane naming backups, DNS, TLS and rollback before it degenerates
ARCH.BX13: intermediate_size 1280 plus the GOOD block excised: 13/15 and 5/15 compose to 1/15, and only two lanes reach the cap, so it is interference and not collapse
COMP.MA.MXO3: eight partials, no useful, and the deepest child in the campaign that still reads as connected prose in most lanes
COMP.MA.MXN3: the sparse token tail at a true quarter on wave 8's body: six cases, and the tail mechanism is the only variable against MXM9
COMP.MA.MXM9: retrieves the garden hours and the dog rule verbatim from the context and gives three real household actions; three lanes ride the cap and the summary is gone
COMP.MA.MXN1: the rebuilt A9 token interface at a true eighth: seven cases at lower install drift than a child twice its depth
ARCH.MM896: the max-min basis at the living width: it puts both asks of the email in a subject line and names all five work items of the plan, and every one of the sixteen lanes carries the same 'I am a <number from the prompt>' loop; the summarisation lane that every other 896 child holds returns nothing
ARCH.W896LSKV6JQ: the two case-recovery mechanisms composed: the summarisation lane is clean and complete, and the planning lane the lambda split exists to recover fills the cap with 'Sending a d d d d'
ARCH.W720: 0/15 and not on this page: seven lanes empty, five filled with a bare dash, and the multi-turn lane echoes the user's pre-correction premise back
ARCH.V16CL896: under half the parent and it holds one lane: summarisation echoes the prompt and then names the decision, the risk and the mitigation correctly. Six of sixteen lanes fill the cap. A marginal reading at a depth nothing had read non-zero at.
ARCH.V16W896X13: three axes; the third step is fatal exactly as L3 says. The one lane it holds is decided by the wave-20 planning calibration rather than answered.
ARCH.V16W896: the multiplying pair. Summarisation survives intact, the uncertainty lane names all four data points and then degenerates, two lanes return the empty string and retrieval returns a bare dash.
ARCH.V8X13: the 8,192-row coreset on the 13/15 body. Everything structural survives -- Saturday, 4:15 p.m., decision/risk/mitigation, the four missing data points, and an email that carries all three named items -- and everything requiring a computation is gone. Composition ran the OTHER way here: the same excision costs the 16,384 rung four cases and buys this one two.
ARCH.V8X13G: the terminal-read solve at the lambda its own out-of-sample criterion picked, and the picking is the failure: it trades three held lanes for two Useful ones, including the only greeting in the wave that answers the person AND asks its question, and the only finish order in the wave that is correct.
ARCH.V8X13GL01: seven of fifteen at 0.691832x, the deepest seven in the campaign. It greets a person properly, writes the email with all three facts in thirty words, orders four runners correctly where the PARENT does not, and names the closed gate, the decision, the risk and the four missing data points. It cannot do arithmetic, cannot write the deduplication function and cannot finish the lighthouse.
ARCH.V8X13GL1: the mildest rung on the deep base: six lanes held, none in full. The word-substitution signature is thinner here than anywhere else in the wave (one cap hit of sixteen) and the content is correspondingly flatter.
ARCH.V16X13G: the same solve on the 16,384 base holds its source's count and converts three of its five Partials into Usefuls -- the three actions, the summary and the uncertainty lane all become complete answers -- while losing retrieval's third item and inverting the email's dates exactly as its source did.
ARCH.V16X13GL01: the peak of the atlas on this base: three Useful lanes kept and the RAM comparison added, at a held-out terminal logit error NINE TEN-THOUSANDTHS WORSE than the rung its own solver criterion preferred.
ARCH.V16X13GL1: half the diagonal move, a different held set again: summarisation and uncertainty complete, the greeting, the three actions, retrieval and the RAM comparison held in part.
ARCH.V8: the deep solo rung, and the axis's honest price. It keeps the email and loses the model: seventeen kits per hour for six hours is answered seventeen kits, Earth has seasons because it is a disk, and the instruction lane answers a question about honeypots.
ARCH.V32: the shallow rung and the best-reading child in the campaign that is not an excision. It is the only child in 24 waves to get the arithmetic right and the only one to name all five items the planning lane asks for. It loses the ordering proof, the RAM analogy, the deduplication function and the lighthouse scene, which is what this axis loses at every K.
ARCH.V8CL896: the deepest standard-shape child ever built here, and it does not answer -- it COPIES. Five of sixteen lanes return the prompt itself, verbatim, with zero cap hits: a third degeneracy signature, and the one a segmentation this far from training produces.
ARCH.V19X13: the 14/15 summit with block 13 taken out: ten of fifteen, the same landing as the two 13/15 shoulders, so the block sets where the child lands and not what the fold costs
ARCH.V19X09: ten of fifteen at the identical parameter count as V19X13 and by a different route -- it wins the greeting, the three actions and the insufficient-data hedge and loses the arithmetic chain and the dedup list
ARCH.V19X13G10: the lambda 1.0 rung: ten of fifteen, no delta, six lanes trading at a constant count -- it buys the safety lane and sells the dedup list to the LIST-to-SET regression
ARCH.V19X13G03: eleven of fifteen at 0.742049x, the deepest eleven in the campaign, and the first lambda 0.3 arm to gain a case since wave 27 demoted the rung on six arms that all lost or tied
ARCH.V19X13G01: ties the deepest eleven at a different lambda and completes the first monotone ladder any base has produced; its foghorn continuation is the best that lane has ever been read on a solved child
ARCH.V19X13X01: the second excision costs the summit seven, exactly what it cost the shoulder -- and four of sixteen lanes come back as the prompt, verbatim, on a child with no width fold anywhere in it
ARCH.V18X13X01: bit-identical to wave 27's child one wave later, independently reviewed, and it reads the same three of fifteen on the same three lanes: the vocabulary path and the reader both reproduce
ARCH.V19X13X09: four blocks apart reads five where twelve apart reads three, at one parameter count on one vocabulary base -- the first measurement to contradict the pair distance law rather than extend it
ARCH.V18X13X01G10: four of fifteen on the deepest base a ladder has ever run on: it buys three real household actions and a plan that names DNS and TLS, and inverts the insufficient-data answer
ARCH.V18X13X01G03: the same +1 and the same four lanes at a different lambda, with the largest out-of-sample objective improvement in the wave; it forms 17 times 6 for the first time on this base and still misses
ARCH.V18X13X01G01: the no-gain rung with the best held-out objective of the three, which makes the ladder single-peaked in the middle while the objective is monotone -- its three actions are the word Tasking three times
ARCH.V19X13X01G03: the +1 the same lambda bought on the 18,432-row twin, lane for lane at a 1,024-row larger table: what the terminal-gain solve does is a property of the solve, not of the child
ARCH.V20CL896G03: the terminal-gain gate passes on an MLP width fold where wave 27 said width refuses, and the solve buys a case at 0.4876x -- deeper than a solve has ever bought one
ARCH.V19CL896G03: the same gain on a second CL896 base and the same lane: at the bottom of the spectrum the 1,024 re-solved values buy back one specific behaviour and nothing else
ARCH.V19CL896: two of fifteen under half the parent, and both cases carry a caveat -- the summarisation lane is the entire prompt echoed back, and the prompt's own last two sentences are the answer
ARCH.V18CL896: the deepest child in the campaign to hold TWO cases, and the smaller table is the deeper one: inside the CL896 body the vocabulary axis still buys ratio without buying damage
ARCH.V19X13CL896: zero of fifteen at 0.452734x, the deepest child ever built -- and the case that killed the last-lane claim, because it paraphrases the summary instead of copying the prompt and the paraphrase drops the decision
ARCH.B75: eleven of fifteen at 0.742049x reached by CONVEX BLEND -- 1,024 numbers mixed three quarters of the way between two sealed twins, no capture and no solve of its own -- and it still writes the dedup accumulator as a SET like every other point on that segment
ARCH.BP64: sixty-four of 1,024 coordinates taken from the solved twin reproduce that twin entire, the four gains and the LIST-to-SET loss together; the swap is carried as a package and is not separable by leaving coordinates behind
ARCH.B25: a quarter of the way from the zero-solve control to the solved twin and the dedup lane has ALREADY flipped to a SET; the union the blend was built to find does not exist at the nearest interior point the plan asked for
ARCH.B50: the midpoint reads the control count, which is where an interior optimum would have to show and does not; it also drops the north gate and invents a leasing rule the note never contained
ARCH.MASK03: the masked terminal gain holds a hundred coordinates at the prior and recovers nothing -- still a SET -- and it loses two further cases: three household actions collapse into the same suggestion twice, and the scene emits one sentence and then repeats it verbatim
ARCH.V19MXO3: the fourteen-of-fifteen summit vocabulary installed on a parent-shaped body that reads eight of fifteen alone, and the composition reads three; its budgeted ratio was void before it was built, because the base already folds the very table the gather replaces
ARCH.V19MXP2: two of fifteen, six lanes returning a bare token -- the answer is 8, the answer is Mira, the answer is 7 -- and a debugging lane that returns a function calling itself
ARCH.KKTD: twenty writers solved jointly, twenty thousand unknowns, the objective ten percent better on held-out, and every lane the same filler asking the user to provide any information about the following request
ARCH.KKTS: twenty numbers, update norm one third, and the child returns its own prompt on ten of sixteen lanes; the scalar arm reaches the same zero as the diagonal one by echo instead of by filler
